messages.author: c3c96c5db9162fe0
messages.subject: can't get auto_test to respond
parts:
Hi there,

I'm trying to get auto_test from the testthat package to work, but it doesn't seem to update when I change the source file. So here's the contents of toy.R:

toy <- function(a,b) {
a+b+1
}


And the contents of test-toy.R

expect_that(toy(2,2), equals(4))


When I do this, everything works as expected...

> source("toy.R")

> test_dir("./")

1


1. Failure(@test-toy.R#1): (unknown) -------------------------------------------

toy(2, 2) not equal to 4

Mean relative difference: 0.25




Now, I do this and get the expected error...

> auto_test(code_path="./", test_path="./")

Error: toy(2, 2) not equal to 4

Mean relative difference: 0.25




But when I go in and change toy.R to:


toy <- function(a,b) {
a+b
}

and save, nothing happens in the terminal.


Am I missing something? My understanding was that it would automatically re-run the tests when I saved toy.R. 

Thanks,
Pat



Here's my info...

> sessionInfo()

R version 3.1.1 (2014-07-10)

Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin13.1.0 (64-bit)


locale:

Hi Pat,

Hmmm, I suspect because I never expected you to put the test and the
code in the same directory. I'd recommending adopting the standard
package layout.

Hadley
